text: The latest update did not improve battery life at all.

text: This app is no longer reliable on my phone.
rationale: Strong positive cue reliable negated by no longer; tests cue-vs-context handling

text: The team won the championship final last weekend.

text: I cannot say that I enjoyed this experience.
rationale: Double negation-like structure where cannot say... enjoyed implies negative sentiment.

text: This app fails to provide even basic functionality.
rationale: Uses fails to as a negation of a positive concept.

text: It is not the worst app, but it is certainly not the best.
rationale: Balanced negation that should land in neutral.

text: The interface is a masterpiece of confusion.
rationale: Masterpiece is a strong positive trigger used ironically/metaphorically for a negative state.

text: I am happy to delete this from my phone.
rationale: Happy is a positive trigger, but the context of delete makes it negative.

text: This is a great example of how not to design a UI.
rationale: Great is positive, but used to describe a failure.

text: Heat the oven to 350 degrees and grease a 9-inch pan.

text: The stock market saw a significant dip in tech shares today.
rationale: Financial news; tests domain robustness.

rationale: Standard filler text; should be neutral.

text: Bad.
rationale: Extreme short text; tests if model can handle minimal context.

text: Love it.
rationale: Extreme short text (positive).

text: I have been using this app for three years now through various updates and iterations and I must say that while the initial versions were somewhat buggy the developers have really stepped up their game recently to the point where I can not imagine my daily routine without it even if the subscription price is a bit high for what it offers at the end of the day.
rationale: Extreme long text; tests handling of long-range dependencies and verbosity.

text: Total garbage. Waste of time. Don t download. Broken. Useless. Terrible. Awful. Worst app ever. Zero stars. Disappointed. Frustrated. Annoyed. Angry. Hate it. Delete immediately. Never again. Scams. Avoid. Warning. Warning. Warning.
rationale: Staccato long text composed of many negative triggers.

rationale: Surface great vs intended frustration.

text: I love how it crashes every time I open a menu.
rationale: Surface love vs intended frustration.

rationale: Surface thanks/appreciate vs intended anger.

text: Wow, such a useful feature that I will never use.
rationale: Surface useful vs irony.

text: The app is 10/10 but the support is 0/10.
rationale: Mixed sentiment with numerical cues; tests if model averages the two.

text: It is okay I guess.
rationale: Vague sentiment; tests the neutral boundary.
Punctuation only; tests if the model hallucinates sentiment from noise.

text: I would not recommend this to my worst enemy.
rationale: Negation of recommend combined with worst enemy.

text: A wealth of bugs.
rationale: Wealth is usually positive, but here it describes an abundance of errors.

text: The mitochondria is the powerhouse of the cell.
rationale: Scientific fact; tests domain shift.
